title: 第1658章 戏弄绝色美女金素梅第1657章 七长老金素梅
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: 这双玉手白皙粉嫩如玉，十指纤细，没有一丝瑕疵，仿佛是上天的杰作。
郑元也不由心猿意马了起来。
七长老金素梅却是俏脸上的红晕越来越浓。
虽然对方是自己的老祖，但毕竟是一个男人。
金素梅在族中一直是洁身自好，冰清玉洁。
从没有被任何一个男人接触过身体。
不由又羞又无可奈何，这应该是长辈对晚辈的关怀吧。
果然，郑元幻化成的金乌老祖叹了一口气。
“小素梅，百年未见你，这怎么都瘦了，一定是平常闭关苦修，不好好吃饭吧……”
金素梅娇躯一哆嗦，那就是一双玉臂到了老祖手里，并且还摸了起来。
“老祖，弟子感觉不瘦，这样子挺好的……”
金素梅俏脸羞得通红一片，低着头，嘴里发出的声音跟蚊子般。
想要挣扎却又不敢，唯恐惹恼了老祖。
况且老祖这是对晚辈的关怀，所以人僵硬的站在那里，任凭老祖在胳膊上摸来摸去的。
心里却是羞涩不已，差点钻进地缝里。
要是换做其他人，早就在他身上刺出成百上千个窟窿了。
“老祖，咱们，咱们是不是先抓那个外族的坏人啊？”
胳膊又酥又痒，金素梅咬着嘴唇，声音都颤抖了。
“不急，那坏人绝逃不出这扶桑渊的，老祖我刚才已经布置下了一道屏障……”
郑元此时心花怒放，心里暗暗得意洋洋着。
不得不说，这女人的一双玉臂宛若初春凝霜的羊脂暖玉。
虽然隔着衣服，但依然能感受到肌理细腻滑嫩，触手温软，指尖微微一触便漾开细碎的酥麻。
连腕间淡浅如玉晕的肌肤都透着几分少女独有的清甜软嫩。
郑元指尖故意慢悠悠摩挲着她小臂细腻的皮肉，眼底藏着几分不易察觉的玩味。
嘴上却依旧端着金乌老祖慈和长辈的腔调，语气里带着几分心疼。
“修行固然要紧，可身子骨也得照料妥当，你瞧这臂膀，都少了几分丰润。”
金素梅浑身绷得僵直，耳根红得快要滴血，细密的薄汗顺着鬓角滑落，落在光洁的颈侧。
浑身皮肉都被那温热的触碰搅得又麻又软，心底羞意翻涌，偏偏半分反抗都不敢生出。
自幼恪守族中规矩，守身自持，从未与异性有过半分肌肤相触，如今被老祖这般抚弄，浑身气血都乱了章法。
脑袋更加垂得极低，长长的睫毛不住轻颤，声音细弱得几乎听不清。
“多谢老祖挂念，弟子日后一定多多调养……”
只不过金素梅下一刻也不由傻眼了。
那就是老祖依然没有松开自己的意思。
虽然对方是自己的老祖，但男女授受不亲。
这么亲昵的接触，金素梅感觉浑身上下都发热了起来，心里又羞又涩。
但又不敢敢反抗，声音变得更加颤抖了起来。
“老，老祖，那外族修士诡计多端，万一借着渊底地形藏起来，耽搁久了恐生变数，不如弟子随老祖一同前去搜捕？”
郑元轻笑一声，羞涩妩媚的模样，心中快意更甚，面上依旧一派威严老成。
“区区宵小，有老祖我屏障封锁，绝对插翅难飞。”
content_en:
These jade hands are as white and pink as jade, with slender fingers and no flaws, as if they are a masterpiece from heaven.
Zheng Yuan couldn't help but become distracted.
The blush on the seventh elder Jin Sumei's pretty face is getting thicker and thicker.
Although the other party is his ancestor, he is still a man after all.
Jin Sumei has always been clean and pure in the clan.
I have never been touched by any man.
I can't help but feel ashamed and helpless. This should be the care of the elders for the younger ones.
Sure enough, the Golden Crow Patriarch that Zheng Yuan transformed into sighed.
"Xiao Sumei, I haven't seen you in a hundred years. Why have you lost weight? It must be because I practice hard in seclusion and don't eat well..."
Jin Sumei's delicate body trembled as a pair of jade arms fell into the ancestor's hands and she even touched them.
"Ancestor, this disciple doesn't feel thin. It's good to look like this..."
Jin Sumei's pretty face turned red with embarrassment, she lowered her head and made sounds like mosquitoes.
He wanted to struggle but didn't dare, for fear of offending his ancestor.
Moreover, the ancestor was caring for the younger generation, so he stood there stiffly and allowed the ancestor to touch his arm.
But I was so shy that I almost crawled into the cracks in the ground.
If it had been anyone else, hundreds of holes would have been pierced into his body.
"Ancestor, let's, let's catch that foreign bad guy first?"
Her arms felt numb and itchy. Jin Sumei bit her lip, her voice trembling.
"Don't worry, the bad guy will never escape from Fusangyuan. Ancestor, I have just set up a barrier..."
Zheng Yuan was elated at this time, and he was secretly proud of himself.
It has to be said that this woman's jade arms are like the warm jade of mutton fat condensed with frost in early spring.
Even through the clothes, you can still feel the delicate and smooth texture, the warm and soft tentacles, and the fine numbness that spreads out with a slight touch of your fingertips.
Even the skin as light as jade halo between the wrists has a bit of sweetness and tenderness unique to girls.
Zheng Yuan's fingertips deliberately and slowly rubbed the delicate flesh of her forearm, with a hint of playfulness hidden in his eyes.
However, he still spoke in the tone of Jinwu Patriarch's kindness and elders, with a bit of heartache in his tone.
"Practice is important, but the bones of the body must also be taken care of properly. Look at these arms, they are a little less plump."
Jin Sumei's whole body was tense and stiff, her ears were so red that they were almost bleeding, and thin beads of sweat slid down her temples and landed on the smooth side of her neck.
The flesh all over his body was numb and soft from the warm touch, and he was so embarrassed that he didn't dare to resist at all.
He has abided by the rules of the clan since he was a child, kept himself in check, and never had any skin-to-skin contact with the opposite sex. Now that he was caressed by his ancestor like this, all the energy and blood in his body were messed up.
His head hung even lower, his long eyelashes could not help but tremble, and his voice was so thin that it was almost inaudible.
"Thank you for your concern, ancestor. I will definitely take good care of you in the future..."
But Jin Sumei couldn't help being dumbfounded the next moment.
That means the ancestor still has no intention of letting go of himself.
Although the other person is his ancestor, men and women are not close to each other.
Such an intimate contact made Jin Sumei feel hot all over her body, and she felt shy and astringent.
But he didn't dare to resist, and his voice became even more trembling.
"Old, Ancestor, that foreign monk is full of tricks. If he hides in the terrain at the bottom of the abyss, something might happen after a long delay. How about my disciples go with Ancestor to hunt him down?"
Zheng Yuan chuckled lightly, looking shy and charming, his heart even more happy, but his face still looked dignified and mature.
"It's just a small thing, but with the barrier of my ancestors blocking it, it's absolutely impossible to fly."
